task: H-Neurons causal ablation K-sweep with mean-substitution (#2209)
verdict: NOT causal even up to K=1000 with mean-substitution: honesty-neuron ablation never degrades the output preference distinctly beyond a random control. The H-Neurons are a strong DETECTOR (0.97 AUROC) but not a causal over-compliance lever here — predictive != causal on Ouro's output margin. Robust null.
caveats: fp16 ByteDance/Ouro-1.4B-Thinking, mean-substitution ablation across all layers/UT, 80 matched facts; the output margin is a weak target (baseline acc ~0.68 — the model barely knows many facts parametrically). A compliance/instruction-following behavior may show causality the factual margin doesn't.
